name: Match history for a model
description: The limit default is computed in a map task, not inline in params: db_read folds {"var": ..} nodes only. See orion-gaps.md N1. It is the string "25" because that is what ?limit= delivers; the placeholder's declared type converts (orion-gaps.md N6). Postgres builds the response: the `body` column is json_agg, and since Orion 1.6 a json column decodes as the document itself, so the respond task copies it into data.body. The GIN containment operator @> is why this is raw SQL rather than the portable dialect.

input.query: SELECT coalesce(json_agg(x ORDER BY x.played_at DESC), '[]'::json) AS body FROM ( SELECT mt.id, g.slug AS game, mt.reason, mt.played_at FROM matches mt JOIN games g ON g.id = mt.game_id WHERE mt.model_ids @> ARRAY[($1)::uuid] ORDER BY mt.played_at DESC LIMIT ($2)::int) x
